scope: Dart/Flutter dependencies, local plugin declarations and shared native libraries outside emulator engines. No IPA build, release, tag, code execution, Flutter test or dependency installation was performed.

public_baseline_notice_evidence.coverage_method: Compare each exact package root license against decompressed Flutter NOTICES.Z and CocoaPods acknowledgement FooterText, normalizing whitespace only.
public_baseline_notice_evidence.coverage_limit: Baseline evidence applies only to public 0.0.8/build480; future IPA contents must be inspected separately. It proves root notice text presence, not complete transitive native license/source compliance.

flutter_sdk.collector_behavior: Reads a package root NOTICES, otherwise LICENSE; additional paths require flutter.licenses. Does not recursively collect native LICENSE files or singular NOTICE by default.

open_items.finding: Local podspec declares MIT but there is no standalone package LICENSE. No third-party origin was identified from the package metadata. Confirm the intended grant with the owner; this audit does not create one.
Preserve actual future Podfile.lock, Manifest.lock, local specs, SDK/engine identity and final notices. Google Cast transitive GTMSessionFetcher is not version-pinned in its podspec.

SoLoud Xiph .a binaries have exact measured digests and source recipe pins, but no reproducible binary match. PDFium original/repackaged sections match; full corresponding-source closure is not established by that comparison.
Repackager release says 144.0.7811.0 whereas original VERSION says 149.0.7811.0; branch/build family 7811 and compiled-section correspondence are recorded instead of silently choosing one label.
Google Cast SDK is declared Commercial with Google API/Cast terms. Its OpenSourceLicenses files apply to listed components and do not authorize relicensing the entire SDK.
Anta OFL is now centrally preserved. No product code was modified to add it to Flutter LicenseRegistry; final app notice accessibility remains a packaging/UI verification item.
